items.title: Tarsus joins Stargardt race to market with $800m Alkeus takeover
items.summary: Alongside Alkeus, companies like Belite Bio, Ocugen and Nanoscope are aiming to secure a place on the Stargardt market with no approved drugs.

items.title: Context drops bispecific T-cell engager on cost-cutting initiative
items.summary: Following the discontinuation of CT-95, Context will now focus on the two other BiTEs in its pipeline, CTIM-76 and CT-202.

items.title: Moderna mRNA flu shot wins FDA approval but awaits CDC recommendations
items.summary: The approval means mFlusiva becomes the first mRNA-based vaccine to be authorised on the US market for flu prevention.

items.title: Evotec and Odyssey collaborate on AI-enabled R&D
items.summary: Evotec and Odyssey Therapeutics have announced a strategic AI-enabled R&D partnership to explore new treatments for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.

items.title: Mediar and Ono Pharmaceutical to develop fibro-inflammatory treatments
items.summary: Mediar Therapeutics has announced a collaboration and option agreement with Ono Pharmaceutical to develop treatments for fibro-inflammatory diseases.
